The '''Drup's Star system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The Drup's Star system contained [[Drup's Star]], [[Drup's Companion]], the planets [[Drup I]], [[Drup II]], and [[Drup III]], as well as the [[Drup Asteroid Field]].
